verdict_basis: Every identity, provenance and corroboration gate was independently confirmed, and the Windows MVP8 exact gate itself PASSED on the frozen subject (attempt-1: exit 0, manifest passed=true, 20/20 checks true, 14/14 negative controls rejected, fatal_logs=[], subject_head/tree and pinned engine sha exact). However, two mandatory Windows evidence items could not be completed by this verifier for documented environment reasons that are NOT product defects: (1) the independent Windows full world/core run could not be executed because the shared host entered a machine-level multi-process ENet regression ~00:25-00:30 (accepted MVP7 graphical-reconnect control on the same frozen tree reproduces the identical gateway-init failure; single-process and raw UDP loopback stay healthy; correlated with Hyper-V VM churn, machine-wide 'Stop-Process -Name *godot*' kills by a concurrent session, free-RAM drop to ~5.3 GB); (2) the raw per-role result JSONs of the passing Windows run vanished from disk after the run through external interference (sealed inside manifest.json files[] with sha256; snapshot+hash regime adopted afterwards). No product defect was found anywhere: FIX_REQUIRED is explicitly not applicable; the gap is evidence-side only.
